title: GSE V1 hard-peak failure attribution and V2 loss readiness
purpose: Use only frozen V1 outputs and one real readiness batch to distinguish angular localization signal from high-confidence ghost peaks and qualify one loss-only V2 corrective.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training V1 attribution/V2 loss readiness on frozen C07/C08 predictions plus eight real C01-C08 rows; no optimizer, checkpoint write, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed V1 three-seed checkpoints and C07/C08 predictions.
Sealed circular peak Teacher and deduplicated LiDAR shards.

worlds.fit: Frozen V1 fit worlds only; no new fit occurs.
worlds.selection: C07 chooses the radius provenance; C08 is confirmatory and cannot select a V2 hyperparameter.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Read every frozen C07/C08 ensemble confidence exactly once for attribution and the same deterministic eight-row readiness batch; no resampling, fitting or model update.

teacher.source: Frozen binary center peaks, masked geometry and V1 predictions.
teacher.use: C07 nearest-local-maximum p90 fixes radius 4 bins. Soft circular heatmap retains unit centers; focal heatmap and equal-count top hard-negative ranking are tested synthetically and on all three frozen backbones.
teacher.valid_mask: Same V1 masks; only the presence loss is replaced.
teacher.student_input: Five causal LiDAR frames only for the eight-row backward check.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None. C07 selects only loss support radius from frozen error attribution; C08 confirms without changing it.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 C08 has been observed and is explicitly not a clean V2 selection source.

methods.main: Radius-4 circular soft heatmap with canonical focal exponents 2/4 plus one top outside-support hard negative per true peak and zero-margin pairwise softplus ranking.
methods.baseline: Frozen V1 exact-bin equal-mass BCE predictions and top4/NMS decode-only upper bounds.
methods.fallback: If angular signal, failure reproduction, loss ordering, hard-negative gradient, rotation or real finite backward fails, stop V2.

acceptance.attribution: Reproduce exact V1 AP; C07 ±10-degree AP>=0.89 and offset p90=4 bins; decode-only below 20 degrees remains insufficient.
acceptance.loss: Correct-center loss < one-bin-shift < far-shift and < added-hard-ghost; hard ghost gradient suppresses and center gradient promotes.
acceptance.equivariance: Soft target rotation error zero, unit center, positive radius-4 edge and zero outside.
acceptance.real_batch: All three frozen backbones have finite V2 backward and positive suppressing gradient at every row's top outside-support negative.

failure_policy: Fail closed; do not change support radius, focal exponents, ranking count, split or V1 evidence after execution.
retention: Retain attribution CSV, summary, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, real-seed gradients, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU frozen-output attribution and three eight-row backward passes
